caption_zh: 攻防共演化收敛曲线。X 轴为演化代数（generation_id），Y 轴为比率（0-1）。红线为未演化（基线）防线在 held-out 变异集上的拦截率，蓝线为演化防线在同一 held-out 集上的拦截率，灰虚线为基线防线在明文攻击集上的拦截率（“本来能拦”的参照水平），橙线为演化防线在良性语料上的误伤率。数据来源：coevolution_log.jsonl 的 intercept_rate_baseline_zeroday / intercept_rate_evolved_zeroday / benign_false_positive_rate 字段；明文参照取 coevolution_evidence.json 的 plain_attack_baseline_intercept_rate。诚实边界：held-out 集是同一批种子的 held-out split，不是分布外数据；变异为确定性规则变异（编码/词表/嵌套），不是 LLM 红队；本阶段零模型调用。（本图 run_id：run-20261028-185512；20 代；15 patches；生成时间 2026-10-28T19:04:05+08:00。）
caption_en: Evolution convergence curve of the attack-defense loop. X: evolution generation (generation_id); Y: rate (0-1). Red: baseline (non-evolved) defense intercept rate on held-out mutations; blue: evolved defense on the same held-out set; grey dashed: baseline defense intercept rate on the plaintext attack set (reference level); orange: benign false-positive rate of the evolved defense. Sources: coevolution_log.jsonl fields intercept_rate_baseline_zeroday / intercept_rate_evolved_zeroday / benign_false_positive_rate; plaintext reference from coevolution_evidence.json plain_attack_baseline_intercept_rate. Honesty note: the held-out set is a held-out split of the same seed pool, not out-of-distribution data; mutations are deterministic rule mutations, not an LLM red team. (run_id: run-20261028-185512; 20 generations; 15 patches; generated 2026-10-28T19:04:05+08:00)

determinism.note: 变异流/绕过序列/拦截率同 seed 可复现；补丁 id 由规范账本状态决定（官方 run 写唯一规范账本），复跑 id 顺延；单 run 内每代候选账本快照保证可回溯

limitations: 变异引擎是确定性规则变异（编码/词表/嵌套），不是 LLM 红队；不得写成“自主攻防智能体”。
语言变异是离线词表近似（provenance: offline_glossary），不是真实机器翻译。
api_tokens_used == 0 是事实：本阶段零模型调用，token 预算停止条件未获真实检验（代码路径已实现，仅由单元测试注入模拟值验证触发）。
被测防线是 Phase A 规则型闸门（词表匹配），编码变异能绕过属可预期；本文贡献是闭环自愈机制与度量方法，不是“Phase A 很弱”。
零日集与训练集来自同一批种子的不同 split，不是独立分布外数据（not OOD）；只能说 held-out 变体，不许写“零日/未见攻击”当 OOD 证据。
零日集按 Lead 口径用 generation_id=0 变异分布（与训练流同变异强度、只差 held-out 种子），避免把“泛化”与“攻击变强”混在一起；口径见 evidence.zeroday_protocol。
回归锁口径：audit892 = 2026-10-27 审计快照的 14 文件口径；今天同口径实测 915 项，与 892 不可换算，报告须注明口径与实测值。
tests/test_chaos_campaign.py 的 3 项失败属沙箱写权限环境性失败（非断言失败），不计入补丁判定（audit892 集合不含该文件）。
补丁以 run 目录内 evolved_patch_snapshot.json 快照形式保存；rules/candidate_patch.yaml 属 A1 写作用域，本脚本不写候选/生产规则文件，生产规则零改动。
A1 内部良性自检结果通过 LAST_ADJUDICATION 回传；A5 另以“演化防线对良性语料实测误伤率 > 基线”作为第二道闸门，不满足则丢弃本代补丁并记录 rejected。
官方 run 的候选账本按 Lead 裁决写规范入口 rules/candidate_patch.yaml（A1 persist），run 目录另存每代快照 candidate_patch_snapshot_g<g>.yaml 供单 run 回溯；生产规则零改动，合入生产 = H0 人工审批。
A5 未调用 A1 的 write_proposal（proposals/phase-b 属 A1 写作用域）；如需 PROP-*.yaml 人工审批件，由 Lead/A1 依据规范账本条目生成。
determinism：同 seed 的变异流、绕过序列与各拦截率可复现；但补丁 id 由规范账本当前状态决定（Lead 裁决官方 run 写唯一规范账本 rules/candidate_patch.yaml），复跑时 id 会顺延——单 run 内每代 candidate_patch_snapshot_g<g>.yaml 保证可回溯。
本 run 的逐代原始数值见 experiments/phase-b/runs/run-20261028-185512/coevolution_log.jsonl（20 行）；回归锁明细见 regression_gen*.json。

limitations: held-out set = held-out split of the same seed pool; it is NOT out-of-distribution data (contract §8.5), so the figure must not be cited as OOD evidence.

mutations are deterministic rule mutations (encoding / offline glossary / nesting), not an LLM red team (contract §8.1); the language variants are offline-glossary approximations, not real machine translation (contract §8.2).
api_tokens_used = 0 in this phase; the token-budget stop condition was never exercised (contract §8.3).
the grey plaintext reference is a single baseline measurement (one value per run), not a per-generation measurement; its provenance is recorded in `lines[*].source`.

each logged rate is measured AFTER that generation's patch/regression step (contract §6.2 order 4)->5)): generation 0 already contains the gen-0 patch, so the blue curve does NOT start at the unpatched baseline level. The unpatched comparison is the red line (held-out) and the grey dashed line (plaintext); the 'gen-0 caveat' is `figure_data.plateau` / this limitation, and no pre-patch gen-0 measurement exists in coevolution_log.jsonl.

defense under test is the Phase A rule gate (vocabulary matching), so encoding mutations bypassing it is expected; the contribution claimed is the closed-loop self-healing mechanism and the measurement method, not 'Phase A is weak' (contract §8.4).
PDF is hand-written vector output (no matplotlib): base-14 Helvetica, ASCII text only; the Chinese caption lives only in this JSON file.

held-out evaluation-set protocol (from coevolution_evidence.json): held-out seeds x generation-0 mutation distribution; blue team never sees these payloads; held-out mutations are NOT OOD data; zeroday_generation_id=0 -- the mutation strength of the held-out set is fixed at generation 0, so movement of the red/blue curves reflects the defense, not a stronger attack stream. This run's zeroday set: 40 payloads.

plateau is data, not smoothing: the evolved defense stays at 0.775 on the held-out set from generation 1 through generation 19 (19 of 20 generations); the accepted patch count grows from 2 to 15 (+13) over that span while the held-out interception rate gains exactly 0 -- rule-level self-healing consumes surface forms but not rewrites that destroy semantic surface evidence.
